params.name: created
params.description: A date/time (UTC) interval for filtering signal events based on their creation date. Defaults to NOW - 7 days if omitted. Users with limited access can only provide the default or a smaller date window.

params.name: updated
params.description: A date/time (UTC) interval for filtering signal events based on their last updated date. Defaults to NOW - 7 days if omitted. Users with limited access can only provide the default or a smaller date window.

params.name: themes
params.description: Comma delimited string of theme ids. Full list of signal themes can be viewed at /themes.

params.name: categories
params.description: Comma delimited string of category ids. Full list of signal categories can be viewed at /categories.

params.name: userRelevanceScore
params.description: A range for filtering signal events based on their relevancy score.

items.docs: Fetch FactSet entity IDs for events that match the filtering criteria
Fetch FactSet entity IDs for events that match the filtering criteria

params.name: _sort
params.description: The entity field to sort on. Can only be sorted on entity key, description or secondary key fields. Append "-" to sort in descending order. If no parameter given, it will be sorted by key field in ascending order by default

params.name: _paginationLimit
params.description: Non-negative maximum number of entries to return. Default is 25

params.name: _paginationOffset
params.description: Non-negative number of entries to skip. Default is 0

params.name: showAll
params.description: Whether to show all field values for each entity row. Value should either be 1 or 0. Default is 0 (false)

items.docs: Gets the entity values for the specified entity
